title: Pattern Formation in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.37921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What are the inductive biases of a Transformer architecture? Existing theory on how the forward pass shapes representations either considers whether Transformers escape from rank collapse or demonstrates that self-attention drives tokens toward cluster patterns. The latter view arises from an elegant dynamical systems perspective, but relies on simplified architectural assumptions, and does not explain the rich structures observed in practice. This leaves a major open question: when a full Transformer escapes rank collapse, how does it structure token representations? Using pattern-formation theory, we show that the dynamical view of Transformers can account for Positional Encoding, Multi-Head Attention, and Output-Value geometry. We demonstrate that a full Transformer architecture imposes an inductive prior by selectively amplifying a rich set of previously unreported patterns, including traveling or rotating waves among others. translated_abstract: Transformer架构的归纳偏置是什么？关于前向传播如何塑造表示的现有理论，要么考察Transformer能否摆脱秩坍缩，要么证明自注意力机制会驱使词元趋向聚类模式。后者源于一种优雅的动力学系统视角，但其依赖于简化的架构假设，无法解释实践中观察到的丰富结构。这就留下了一个重大的开放问题：当完整的Transformer摆脱秩坍缩之后，它是如何组织词元表示的？我们运用模式形成理论，证明Transformer的动力学视角能够解释位置编码、多头注意力以及输出-值几何结构。我们展示了完整的Transformer架构通过选择性地放大一组丰富的、此前未被报道过的模式（包括行波与旋转波等）来施加归纳先验。
tldr: 该论文运用模式形成理论证明，完整的Transformer架构会通过选择性放大行波、旋转波等此前未被报道过的丰富模式来施加归纳先验，从而解释了位置编码、多头注意力与输出-值几何结构如何塑造词元表示。
en_tdlr: Using pattern-formation theory, this paper shows that full Transformers impose an inductive prior by selectively amplifying previously unreported patterns such as traveling and rotating waves, explaining how positional encoding, multi-head attention, and output-value geometry structure token representations.
